notes.subject: pasin bilong skelim bilong mi
notes.rationale: משפטי as 'my judgment/verdict' (Yahwe's own justice) vs 'my lawsuit/case' — most versions split between them.

notes.subject: to Iyob
notes.rationale: Direct forensic challenge questions addressed to Iyob.

notes.subject: תרשיעני / תצדק
notes.rationale: Hebrew antithesis 'declare-me-wrong / be-right' (רשע/צדק root pair), softened in Tok Pisin.

translation: A, olsem? Yu laik brukim ⟨את⟩ pasin bilong skelim bilong mi? Yu laik skelim mi i rong, bilong yu i kamap stret?
